capabilities.description: Managers schedule, release and cancel public skating sessions. Customers buy tickets priced per session, with availability that accounts for club bookings and protection against overselling. Unpaid bookings expire after a 15-minute payment window.
capabilities.name: Public skating session scheduling and ticket sales

capabilities.description: Manages the stock of hire skates and reserves skates alongside session bookings.
capabilities.name: Skate hire

capabilities.description: Runs checkout through the PuckPay payment provider, settles payment results from its webhook without double-processing, and refunds tickets when a session is cancelled.
capabilities.name: Online payment and refunds

capabilities.description: Gives members free sessions when they book.
capabilities.name: Membership free-session entitlement

capabilities.description: Clubs book the whole rink or half of it at an hourly club rate, with conflict detection. Clubs get a monthly invoice in which half-rink hours are charged at half the rate.
capabilities.name: Club rink hire and monthly invoicing

capabilities.description: Produces the manager's weekly report: sales, attendance and refunds per session, sessions held or cancelled because of ice, and totals for the week.
capabilities.name: Weekly management reporting

capabilities.description: Checks ice temperature readings from FrostSense sensors. If the ice stays too warm, the next session is put on hold and its booking holders are notified.
capabilities.name: Ice condition monitoring and customer notification
